thread:
Sam Turner: Morning team — quick async standup. Quick updates on roadmap/specs/canary prep.
Sam Turner: What I did: finished spec draft for slow-path routing & cost-controls; demoed to infra yesterday.
Sam Turner: Blockers: waiting on perf numbers from eng-runtime for the quantized model (Avi) — need those to finalize canary SLOs.
Sam Turner: Today: finalize rollout policy doc, push PR for spec updates (#4123), and sync with QA.

Natalie Chen: What I did: completed embeddings cache perf tests; saw ~12% latency win for short queries.
Natalie Chen: Blockers: need final decision on retention window for prefix/KV cache (30m vs 2h). leaning 1h. Thoughts?
Natalie Chen: Today: update docs for cache config & add regression tests.

Avi Kapoor: What I did: ran kernel microbenchmarks on p4d and a100x; will post a short summary in a few.
Avi Kapoor: Blockers: reproducing a tail latency spike in prod-sim — suspect batching behavior at batch=64.
Avi Kapoor: Today: dig into the spike, send numbers to Sam, and draft a short fallback runbook for canary.

Jordan Li: FYI — PR #4150 (routing-policy) needs review. @Lee Martinez can you take a look? small change.
Jordan Li: Also, can we prioritize the canary by traffic class (low-qps sessions first)? proposing rule set in the PR.

Lee Martinez: on it, will review #4150 today.
Lee Martinez: +1 to 1h cache retention. start conservative and iterate.
Lee Martinez: For canary: suggest route 3% of sessions, restrict to sessions <2k tokens, and enforce fallback to stable-v2 on any error.

Sam Turner: @Avi can you add the perf numbers as a gist or paste to this thread? makes signoff quicker.
Sam Turner: @Natalie i'll lock retention to 1h in the draft if no objections in 4h.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-20 09:00 UTC for service=redwood-api, snapshot=v2.3-canary
deploy-bot: Canary policy: 3% sessions, traffic-class=low, fallback=stable-v2

Natalie Chen: noted on timing. QA asked for a pre-run smoke checklist; i'll add a short checklist to the launch doc (steps + quick sanity prompts).
Avi Kapoor: posted gist: https://gist.github.com/avi/perf-222 — includes p50/p90/p99 for batch sizes [1,8,32,64].
Sam Turner: thanks, Avi — that helps. can you confirm `batch=64` runtime param is in the canary config?

Jordan Li: quick ask — anyone available to pair on the rollout test tomorrow 08:30 PT? need one more hand to watch metrics.
Lee Martinez: I can.
Sam Turner: I'll join early and add it to the calendar. :thumbsup:
Natalie Chen: QA will run embedding regression on the canary flag and post results to the release thread.
Jordan Li: OK cool — closing my items. good progress, team.
Sam Turner: Thanks all — if no objections on retention i'll update the spec and merge #4123 after the reviews.
